Since the last pack (exact counts Oct 26; Oct 27 00-08 UTC from hourly data)

Biggest change

  • Uber SMS (Key 1): grease and pagebio TTs ~1.8-1.9M on Oct 26 (about 10x Oct 25) at ~6% verified, peaking 190-225k/h at 18-20 UTC. Since 22 UTC a flat ~17k/h with verified down to 0-4/h, then 123k at 08 UTC today. Being stopped, but the largest live attack. Existing ticket: BLUE-7323.

New since Oct 26

  • Adobe Sign Up (Key 2): back on grease 10.9k Oct 26 / 7.5k today (~30% verified) and single-click 15k / 12.4k (46-55% verified) - partly getting through.
  • Roblox Game Join (Key 6): ends-te 5.8k Oct 26 -> 27k so far today, single-click 22k, dict-3 8.7k; verified 3-6% (being stopped).
  • Adobe Commerce (Key 3): new on secchua-webgl 4.5k Oct 26 / 5.6k today at 71-94% verified - getting through.
  • Smaller: Airbnb Account Lookup webgl 1.8k Oct 26; HPID Returning Users 1.1k on OS spoofing + page-bio null (hold combo).

Still running

  • Microsoft Identity Signup (Key 2): ~158k/day on webgl and dict-3 + dishort300 at 0-3% verified; 69k so far today.
  • Bank of America Beacon Workforce ATM (Key 4): 170k Oct 26, 22k today on dict-3 + dishort300 (BLUE-7297, not created), 0% verified. Confirm it is attack traffic, not a workforce integration.
  • Highlight AI Chat Prompt (Key 1): ~110k/day on grease and pagebio, 0% verified. No ticket yet.
  • gtop100.com: webgl 91k Oct 26 (4% verified), 32k today.
  • Amazon IDS (Key 2): grease/pagebio dipped to ~6-7k Oct 26, back to 41-47k so far today (9% verified); OS spoofing steady ~50k/day.
  • Blizzard Support Site (Key 3): dict-3 and grease 41-43k on Oct 26, 0% verified.
  • Getting through: Wells Fargo Login ~29k/day at 81% verified; Adobe ARP FF webgl and ends-te 34-35k at 58-75%. Adobe Sign-in grease 88k at 99% verified looks legitimate.

Stopped

  • Tinder PreSMS dict-3 (80k Oct 25 -> 0); WBD Account Lookup pagebio/appleos (400k+/day -> ~2k); Olo Payments (0 on every flag); DoorDash Website dict-7 burst over, ja4-dict1 0 today; Roblox Signup ~0 today on dict-3 + dishort300 and dict-7; Amazon IDS dict-3 <1k.

1. g-pagebio-null-cdn-ends-content-length-tz-mismatch-no-vpn-rfc-ct-before-cl livekeep live + review action

Action: Weekend, Oct 16-18: NOT mitigated. Adobe ARP grew to 959k (Oct 16), 1.42M (Oct 17) and 902k (Oct 18), with 59-75% verified. The TT fires, but most of the traffic still gets through. It peaked at 168k/h on Oct 18 12:00 UTC (83% verified) and was down to ~3-4k/h by midnight. This is the top ask: change the action on this key. New keys: WBD Account Lookup (Key 20) 435k on Oct 18 (23% verified; bursts at 06h, 08-09h and 18-20h with a 188k/h peak). WBD Login (Key 8) 203k on Oct 18 (39% verified; 40k/h at 18h and 54k/h at 21-22h). Olo Payments 10k (5% verified, still running). Roblox Signup is steady at ~40k/day.

Appendix — how these were found

Daily run 2026-10-23. Step 1: 40 flags with >=3 keys spiking. Dropped as definition changes, not attacks: g-browser-automation-swiftshader / -basic-render / g-spoofing-webgl-dimensions (created Oct 19, THR-1289, not includable), g-ip-timezone-same-country-wrong-zone (created Oct 20), g-h-capi-version-suspicious and g--e-cope-anomaly-wrong-build-id-for-capi-version(-4-6-0/-4-6-1) (CAPI 4.6.1 release Oct 20), g-ip-connection-type-velocity-* wired (edited Oct 21), g-ip-asn-reputation-high-risk-with-session-signal (created Oct 14, partial baseline), and the 8 spike-scan TTs created Oct 19-20. g--e-g-ja4-suspicious-verification-patterns + page-bio null hit 31 keys, but the Ensemble detector rewrites its JA4 list ~4x/day and it grew from 3-11 hashes to 25 on Oct 22, so it is treated as a definition change. Step 2 (16-flag vocab) found two new combos: g-di-dict-3 1x + di-short-300 pxr1 (10 keys, share 0.84) and g-operating-system-spoofing + page-bio null (9 keys, share 0.75). Both added as candidates with validated drafts.
